review: I must say that I am astounded by the poor service and how useless Uber’s support staff is. It has taken them 3 years and counting for them to resolve a simple request whereby I have consistently been asking them to disable the two step verification on my account. It is to start with stupid to only send codes via a cellphone when one requires both a verified email and cellphone to sign up. I have sent Uber‘s Helpdesk numerous emails over the past 3 years. More recently, which is from this past weekend, I decided to communicate with them via both Twitter and Facebook, all of which incidentally use my common email address. Sadly none of these attempts have yielded any positive results and instead their responses were to repeatedly ask me stuff that I had already provided them. I am very frustrated because instead of resolving my request, I have repeatedly been asked the same set of questions and much to my dismay, even though I answered them but they would just abandon my support tickets. Kindly brace yourself for an annoying experience when you deal with Uber because it is not fun the same question and people act dixlixic by asking you again and again the same thing. I answered their questions in all instances  but still I am locked out of my account. The last ride was unbelievably requested successfully on 08 May 2016.

Last night i had an Uber reserved for 11:15pm, it had been reserved earlier in the day. when it came time for my trip the original driver cancelled and was replaced by another which was fine until i realised the replacement driver was stationed and staying in one spot, 7 minutes away from my pickup location and not moving. upon trying to call him he declined my calls numerous times and did not answer the messages when i messaged on the app. i used a bolt to get home and when i eventually got him the uber driver was still in the same place waiting for me to cancel so that he could get the cancellation fee without having to move. i was eventually charged the
cancellation fee without even cancelling and the driver having not even come to the venue, AN HOUR AND A HALF AFTER THE PICKUP TIME. i have full proof of the driver not being there an hour and a half after the pickup time and his ignorance of my messages. i expect the charged fee of the cancellation fee to be given back to me as it is practically theft.

The standard has seriously dropped. Uber drivers are now behaving like Bolt drivers, there’s a lack of respect. They play their music loud, when you suggest a preferred route they actually argue with you and try to convince you that their route is better especially if you don’t prefer using the freeway where there’s a risk of being stuck in bumper to bumper traffic if there’s an accident or something. Then some of the cars are so dirty and smelly it’s as if they sleep in their cars.
They drive recklessly and speed.
The drivers accept a ride you wait for a while only for them to cancel, some will accept a ride then not move when you call to find out why they aren’t moving they tell you they can no longer come and you should cancel on your side, they actually don’t consider that you could be in a dangerous area and shouldn’t even have your phone exposed to potential criminals.
Uber drivers should also remember which country they work in, as a female living in SA I don’t feel safe someone asking me personal questions like where do you live? Who do you live with? Where are you going? I understand some drivers aren’t criminals and are genuinely just trying to make conversation but with the GBV in the country I don’t feel comfortable answering such questions. There’s should be boundaries.
Thank you to those who have made an effort in being friendly, considerate and professional and keeping their cars clean.

So i come from the Casino, and the driver tells me that the ticket might be a problem, and I tell him not too worry, because whenever i leave the Premises at the Casino, I do not have to pay for Parking, and yet this crooks, keeps charging me R10 after R10 after R10, and after having discussed this with almost 10 different drivers, i can with certainty say that Uber does not pay the tolls over to the drivers, otherwise it could have been considered a tip, and its not even about the money, its the concept, of putting your life in the hand of a bunch of crooks and criminals that is either too clueless or too unconcerned to be bothered about the fact that they actually have the Audacity to steal from you, as that is precisely what it is, before some automated thing tells you no there was tolls, but you know for a fact there was none, as you used your Platinum MVG card to exit the Premises at a Sun International Casino. These people (not the drivers), the criminals hiding behind the automated rubhish responses, should steal less and use their common sense more, or establish with drivers whether or not they had to pay toll fees, but no, why would they add that as a option in the app, they are too criminally inclined and too greedy to think of basic logical reason. And if they driver the day has to pay toll fee's, stop robbing the drivers, without them you are nothing.

The last 3 trips to Cape Town Airport, my driver didn’t end the trip once we reached the end destination, they usually only end it 10-15 minutes after I have already left. I have been over charged every single time. This is such a hassle as the app doesn’t allow for a proper complaint and there is no other way to address this problem. Can’t you add into the app, that the rider can end the trip if they see that it hasn’t yet been done. As this will resolve a lot of issues that are currently being faced.

If possible please let uber drivers send a message when they are being delayed on their way to pick up a rider, as I was waiting for more than 10 minutes looking at the time the driver will take to come and pick me up, with no change in time. I phoned the driver twice on his number and once as an uber call and there was no answer. I then canceled that trip and requested a new one. I was again waiting for more than 10 minutes looking at the time the driver will take to come and pick me up, with no change in time again.  I had to phone the driver twice when he only said that he was on his way.

I have never had an issue with Uber before 2 months ago. If this will be continuing to happen, I will stop using this app and I’ll inform all my friends and family to do the same. Please fix these issues as I believe a lot of customers feel the same way.

On the arrival level at ORT Johannesburg international ground level are pillars on the road. These are numbered in big capital letters. The pillar right opposite the parking where the Uber pick up actually is, is called pillar No2 and on the tar mark it says E. 
The message from the driver - and the app - states go to pillar 2 E. The driver days go to pillar 2 E.  So I thought I was at the right location. But I was not. 
That is not what they want to say. The correct wording is go to level 2 inside the parking area that is the area after you crossed the road and then go up with the escalator to level 2 and first left to area E. That is the area where the Uber will pick you up. 
I can understand that the driver has most likely never arrived by plane and therefore does not know that there are numbered pillars on the arrival road. 
Further in that area level 2 area E where the Uber arrives are people that want to sell you a ride. - be aware that these are not Uber drivers.

Yesterday I sent a rather urgent parcel with an Uber package car, the driver who was very rude firstly lied and said security doesn’t accept deliveries on behalf of tenants which isn’t true, then he said he’s leaving my parcel at their Uber offices in Malboro, AND HE DIDNT! Then he further went on to lie and say he left me missed calls which I ignored I have records of 1 missed call he left me at 16:04 and I called him at 16:05, so he traveled from Midrand to malboro in less than a minute?? I won’t even mention how he started cursing and insulting me, and I’m a woman, I’m sure he would have hit me if I was infront of him.

The worst part of it is that I’ve beeen reporting this on the Uber not a single response from them, I don’t know where this criminal is with my parcel that was meant to leave Jhb tonight for a business commitment. The fact that Uber didn’t get back to me about this and there’s no sense of urgency about a matter so serious really convinces me that they actually condone these criminal activities and ways of their drivers. I am so hurt and so disappointed that was an important parcel. I will never use this app again and I don’t recommend it to anyone, because clearly on days like this Uber management sided with their criminals.

For the first time using the uber ride, was excellent, driver extremely curtious and pleasant. Very good driver with safety in mind not just for me and the family, other road users aswell.
Now upon return could not access my acc, continually saying I should upgrade my tel nr. Upon doing this the final process then says my nr is old and needed upgrading. Landed @ airport 18:00 only got lift or picked up by family 21:00 so thank you for your call centre upon answering the call to put the phone down in my ear. Continually phoning afterwards the person then rejected my following calls. Now how would you expect a great review if only 1 time experience works out a nice one. Look at the future as I had in mind not only using this service as a one time affair. 
Most disgusted traveller with young toddler to get home and fed was a mission.

We did about a dozen rides over a weekend. Without exception the vehicles were in a bad mechanical state. When Uber started, it was all like new corollas etc, no issues. Now it’s old rundown cars with broken suspensions and noisy brakes. 
The Uber app, in the feedback form, doesn’t even have a tick box for that. It has “car not clean” but that’s different (and that wasn’t the problem). Uber should exercise some oversight here. This was scary. 
Other problems were: Drivers accepting then cancelling trips. On occasion, Uber failing to get any driver. Driver not making any attempt to liaise with us regarding pickup, then claiming “no show” fees (ie, us paying twice for the same trip). 
One driver “missed” the turnoff (despite it being shown on the planned route app), then charging us for the detour to track back to the destination. When we tried to query the invoice, driver then claimed that we had requested this detour. Lengthy debates with Uber: I really dont need this. Uber has to keep their drivers honest.

The reason this company will fail is that it treats the customer as if they are always in the wrong with no recourse for the customer. A recent example where a driver went to an incorrect pickup point, and then blamed us not wearing masks as the reason for no pickup. ( we were at the correct pick up point and wearing masks). Drivers are allowed to and encouraged to make up blatant lies a they know the customer never has any recourse. A truly disgusting system of the worst kind. It does however make me feel better to see Uber loosing market share to competitors for the very reason they treat customers a second hand citizens a part of their business model .

The price charged was 80 % more than the estimate given. The traffic was very light and no delays. I went with Taxify the day before, the same route, the estimate given by Taxify was in line with what I was charged. Try phoning or emailing Uber. It would be easier to get through to Buckingham Palace than trying to communicate with Uber. Even when I replied to an email received from them, my email was rejected. Their excuse for the inflated fare was that my destination did not match where I was dropped off, yet the driver picked me at the correct point and dropped me off at the correct destination. I said hello to the driver, and when I exited the vehicle I said thank you and goodbye, I never engaged the driver in conversation. I am going to dispute the amount with Amex, however I hope Uber sort it out and credit me. I am amazed at the number of various companies offering services that do not have a phone line or email address to log a complaint, it’s as if they are happy to accept your business but not interested if you have a problem.

The App needs to be revised to allow for users to comment on trips or raise complaints, including in instances when the complaint is intended for the other driver and not necessarily the one who picked the customer up (as thy may not be at fault). Some drivers abuse the system by picking and choosing the trips they prefer, thus inconveniencing customers. They cancel trips without giving any reason, so that they can pick others that offer more money. I experienced this yesterday when I requested an Uber to pick me up from the Lanseria Airport. The App indicated that the vehicle was on its way to me, 5 minutes away, but then suddenly, the vehicle and driver details changed, and the time of arrival increased to 10 minutes, yet I saw the very vehicle that was supposed to pick me up arriving at the airport and picking someone else up. This is unfair and inconveniencing. Such drivers must be disciplined for treating customers badly just make more money.

Uber is running a scam for those that use card payments on several occasions when I request using a card and then if the trip happens to get cancelled by me or the driver they never refunded me the money, because they have this tendency of deducting the payment as you request even before the driver accepts the ride even today I was requesting 110 rands trip and then the driver cancelled on me they never refunded me my money. I don’t understand how they expect you to request another ride if they have not refunded you that initial money that they took from your account and there is no way to get a hold of them there’s no way communicating them with regards to this sort of issue so that they can refund your money you end up never getting your money back. to me this has happened on several occasions not only once I wouldn’t recommend Uber to anyone who is requesting using their card details.

I tried requesting an Uber to get from the place I drop my vehicle to be serviced back home. However, Uber could not connect me to a driver. This is not the first time that this has happened. I had to then call my wife and ask her to fetch me, which required her to wake up our sick daughter and bring take her out of the house in the cold winter weather. What is the point of Uber if I cannot hail a driver, or if it is extremely effortful and time consuming to wait for a driver to accept my request? I understand that drivers face challenges in terms of the rising cost of fuel, which disincentivises them from taking shorter trips, however as the platform provider Uber should be adapting so that its customers (i.e. riders AND drivers) continue to have a good experience. In the lack of any change to rectify this situation, I don’t see Uber enjoying much patronage from myself and customers like me.

Ugh, I'm so done with Uber! It's only good for when you have absolutely nothing else to do and no sense of urgency whatsoever. Their discounts are a total joke - they just lead to slow or non-existent rides because drivers don't want to accept them. And good luck trying to turn off the discounts - it's impossible!

You'll be stuck waiting 20-30 minutes just to get connected to a driver, and when you finally do, Uber has the nerve to reverse the discounted fee and charge you full price without even asking! It's like they think they can just take your money whenever they feel like it. And don't even get me started on the "convenience" of paying with a card - it's just an excuse for them to scam you.

I'm so over Uber's nonsense. Bolt is the clear winner here - at least they don't waste your time and money with fake discounts and shady business practices.

Requested an Uber the first time and the driver Texted asking where I’m going. I proceeded to tell him, and even after that he asked “where??”. I then asked if the Uber app doesn’t show the destination, and he responded saying it doesn’t. I cancelled because I felt unsafe.

Requested another Uber right after, and the app says “Driver is 6 minutes away” and it’s been almost 30 minutes now. I have tried calling and texting him to no avail and he just ignores the texts. He texted in the beginning saying he’s too far but I couldn’t cancel without being charged because “he’s on his way” . I asked him to cancel so I don’t get charged, but he never responded after that. Since then I’ve called twice and sent several texts. I’m a student and I really don’t have money to waste on such and this is such an unsafe situation, I can’t imagine if I was in a place idk waiting for the “6 minutes” which turns into a whole 45 minutes.

Do better

Uber is super, I am grateful to the person who brought this concept, it really works. The service, security, the recruiting processes, the cars, personality, professionalism, monitoring the trip, look I can go on and on. I thank God for this, due to my medical condition I cannot wake up early and jump off my bed to take my kids to school, but with the help of Uber I know my kids are safely dropped cause I’m monitoring the route, I wish the problems with the local taxi drivers can stop. If possible they need to be equipped I know it will be hard because of their behavior and some their criminal records. My second wish is if we can use satellite to see the route we will be 100,10% comfortable. I’m happy 🙋🏻‍♀️🙏❤️💃🏼👌🏼👍🏻👍🏻😂.

From directing the driver to the pick-up point selected in the app, to navigating during trips, the app has gotten worse with each update! I use an iPhone and never have issues with other GPS-based apps for location sharing or navigation, so I don’t understand why the Uber app/platform sends wrong pick-up locations to drivers, making the process a horrible experience.

Then there’s the in-trip navigation that’s often so way off that the journey becomes longer and consequently costs more. I’ve had to resort to directing the drivers using Waze or Here maps apps on my trips.

Countless regular updates to the app and issues like the above don’t get fixed. This causes a lot of friction between passengers and drivers and making journeys with Uber less than pleasant these days!

I have been a LOYAL uber driver user for years. I have easily driven in over a 150 ubers, yet generally I am left quite disappointed.

I drive quite lengthy trips, and pay a heavty fee each and every time. 9 out of the 10 times I talk to my drivers, they complain about being underpaid. Where is all my money going to??

Most vehicles are in ROUGH state. Many of them do not smell pleasant, and are quite worn-through. I have driven with a few uber drivers that do not practice safe driving protocols in the slightest. Many of which do not even use indicators. My last uber ride, the driver did not even have a driving permit. Previously, I’ve driven with a driver who did not have a rear view mirror (and we drove a long trip).

Recently, a new level of disappointment has been reached. Everyday, there are never ubers available in my area, and I am in Cape Town right across a busy shopping mall (Cape Gate, Northern Suburbs). 

It is extremely disappointing having spent this much money towards your company, and more often than not, it does NOT reflect in quality or service.

Sorry, but Uber South Africa seriously needs to re-strategise in a whole, because at this point your company is a pure money making scheme.

There’s this weird happen that they have nowadays where they authorize payments from YOUR account without asking. First they took an amount out of my account and told me that someone else was using my account and when I asked them to let me know which email address was supposedly using my account, turns out it was mine. They never got back to me on that. Now they have a nasty habit of showing one amount on your receipt and one amount as your trip is ongoing and then deduct a different amount on your bank card but day by day they are becoming scammers. I say scammers because if I ask you why the receipt says something different from my account and all you have to say is “there was some suspicious activity” and then not be able to explain the supposed activity is scamming. So if I would advise people to use cash because at least then they can’t scam you.

I have twice now had episodes of having left something in an Uber. When I contact Uber they tell me that they will refer me to the email team. When I do that I simply get no response or just a computer generated response that tells me that no response is required. I ultimately had to advertise it on Facebook and then after 8 days the Uber driver called and I got my daughters phone back.

The same thing has happened now. I have been calling and emailing since dec 31 - I still have had response from Patrick!!!

That’s what happens when you’re  a monopoly!! It’s a disgrace

Yesterday evening, I called an Uber, and the app showed me that a car was on its way, capable of taking two passengers. However, a delivery van arrived instead. The driver informed me that he was there to pick up a parcel for delivery, based on the information he received. I explained that there must be a mistake in the Uber app and asked him to cancel the trip. I then called for another Uber, double-checking my request to ensure I hadn’t selected the wrong service.

Unfortunately, a delivery van arrived again, and the same mix-up happened for a third time. Eventually, I had to arrange alternative transport. Later, for my return trip, I used Uber again since I had no other options. This time, a proper vehicle arrived, but I was charged double the usual fare. This experience was disappointing and frustrating.

To add to this, two of the previous drivers on motorbikes were visibly upset and accused me of lying about the incorrect service request, which was upsetting.

When I tried to report this issue through the Uber app, I was disappointed to find that there were no options to properly address my concerns. I would appreciate it if Uber could review my experience, as it has left me hesitant to use the service in the future.

I had a tremendously frustrating and disappointing experience with Uber’s package delivery service. I urgently needed to send a client package, and it was picked up as scheduled by a driver named Mosweu Jonas on Thursday at 10:50. However, the service completely failed as the driver ended the trip prematurely and started another, without delivering my package.

To make matters worse, Uber’s client support has been non-existent. Despite my repeated attempts to reach out through emails and visits to their Parktown and Kramerville offices, there’s been no assistance or dedicated team to address my issue. This lack of support is unacceptable, especially in a situation where timely delivery is critical.

As of now, it’s Monday, and not only is my package still missing, but I’ve also been denied entry to the Kramerville office by security when I tried to inquire about my package. Additionally, Uber has not issued any refund for the undelivered package nor provided any information on its whereabouts.

This experience has left me deeply dissatisfied with Uber’s services. The lack of accountability and customer support in resolving such a critical issue is alarming and has caused significant inconvenience and potential loss to my business.

I spent over 40minutes trying to book a driver from Cape Town Int Airport but they all cancelled - more than 30 drivers!!! Bolt was the same, to the point where I was confirming requests on both apps simultaneously to try get home!! A private taxi driver then explained that it’s because the price is too low and doesn’t benefit the driver enough to make the trip, why is this my problem?!? Pay them properly and charge correctly so we can book a ride and not be standing at the airport or on the street late at night waiting for a driver to confirm.

It requested that I pay twice for a ride. Harassed me about it and then the app finally figured out that I had already payed. Also this payment request was super vague and I had to check my bank receipts to figure out where this random number they were charging me was coming from. Also getting rides recently has been a hassle. I never bother drivers, I always greet and say thanks for the ride but I’m still sitting on a 4.2 rating. Apparently it’s because I’m not tipping every driver which honestly shouldn’t bring my rating down this much. I do tip but if all the driver does is chat loudly on the phone through the entire ride I’m obviously not tipping. I will still give them 5 starts always because I arrived at my destination intact, but tipping on a ride that is already R200+ should not be a must.

Recently I requested a ride , but then cancelled because I had another app open with a driver accepting .. I’ve then since cancelled my trip on Uber . However now I’m finding problems with the app not allowing me to request a driver when confirming location or the amount for different options per rides doesn’t show ? When I select the confirm button the cars doesn’t appear ! So idk I haven deleted the app and I have logged out , and signed back on.. and still is it an iPhone problem ? Please help me I use the app quite often . There ain’t options on the app that tells me to convey my current problem I’m facing … hope this can be fixed

Every time the app updates it requires me to sign in again. This would be okay, if the sign in worked. After I press sign in; the page where you enter your phone number doesn’t come up. It just stays blank. Then I may be lucky enough to get through to the page where I can load my phone number, but then after I do that it tells me “oops! Server error!”. This has happened multiple times and is getting very frustrating… as I am a student and rely on Uber for transport to places that are too far to walk. Frankly, it’s dangerous, as it gives no warning to when it will stop, and I could easily be stranded somewhere. Please may you fix this. I continuously am deleting and reinstalling the app, restarting my phone etc. But still, it does this each time. Disappointed.

I’m tired of having to pay so much more money than agreed on initially every time the drivers your brand hires don’t know how to get to the destinations requested and rely solely on the Uber navigation system to guide them there which so far, without fail, has always taken the wrong or an extremely extended route to the destination. I feel like I’m being robbed by Uber every time this happens, especially when I can’t help the driver navigate correctly because I’m on a business call or any other distraction for that matter. 

This last trip I took changed me +R100 more than what I’d budgeted for, leaving me stranded at a time of the year when every coin is precious. It’s honestly not fair and it’s turning me and my community off this Brand completely. 

The worst thing is knowing that nothing will be done about this.

My account was recently blocked without warning or explanation. I only became aware of it when I tried to hail a ride at 2am while far from home - leaving me stranded with no way of contacting Uber (the “help” button loaded a page with a 404 error). When I was eventually able to find a way to make contact the following day, all I got in reply was a “we need to verify your payment methods and will unblock your account once this is done”.
No apology.
And very strange because I had been using the payment methods for years, so why the sudden urgency (and lack of warning)? Surely you’d just ask rather than blocking an account (without explaining why it was blocked)?
Dubious - and irresponsible. If I were a woman and got stranded in the middle of the night because of this, just imagine the possible consequences!

I am currently sitting in traffic because of Uber's routing system. The routing system gave a route to my driver and I which took us DIRECTLY into increasing traffic. Even though a much faster route that was available on Google Maps, was not suggested. 

This is not the first time I am sitting with this problem. I have been using Uber to get to the same destination for over a month. There are so many faster routes to get to this place, once again, provided by Google Maps which Uber just doesn't suggest. 

I hope to see an update to fix this problem or an integration of Google Maps , for drivers.

Uber ZA has to be the WORST! Not only do they double or triple charge you on NUMEROUS OCCASIONS and alter your fare amount when using your card but they also have very rude and disrespectful drivers and they’ve removed their support phone number so there’s no way of reaching them and laying an immediate complaint!
My driver-Avumile who drives a Polo Volkswagen and frequents around Erica Square in Belhar-claimed to have arrived at the destination and I had been outside waiting for him and was rained on trying to look for his car but could not spot him and when I texted him to ask where he was he responded so RUDELY and DISRESPECTFULLY and then cancelled my ride and taking my money! If Uber would like to know I was almost robbed after your incompetent and ill mannered driver left me hanging!
I have given Uber chances on chances but now? Not anymore.

My reason is the fact I lost my AirPods in the Uber and I tracked them for a whole 2 days and I had no way of contacting the driver through the app once the trip was finished I tried calling him but Uber would only let me call once and he never answered the phone just add a message button on the finished trips we don’t need the person number or address just a way to contact with the driver in case of a lost item also going through Ubers way of trying to get ahold of the driver is a total waste of time so just add the button even if it’s for 24 hours after the trip it will still help a bunch because now I have to go out of my way and track down this poor man and ask him to give my my AirPods.

I don’t know what’s happening with this App or Uber as a whole. I’ve been struggling to find drivers for the past few weeks and arriving late or being delayed due to their waiting time. 
In addition to that  they deduct money from your account prior to even confirming your trip or finding a driver. 
The routes being taken to short distance areas lead to being longer than usual as the the drivers or Uber suggest a longer route. 
Then you have the app allowing a driver that’s 13 minutes away accepting your trip like how is that even logical! Uber is about convenience but at the moment it is dismally failing at providing that! 

I’ve been using Uber for more than 5 years and in all my years I’ve never experienced such inconvenience and disappointment. 

Right now as I type this I’ve been requesting since 8am for a ride and I have been having people 13 minutes or 10 minutes away accepting my trips after waiting for another 10 minutes to even get a ride and again I will be late no matter how punctual you may try to be, Uber is not about your business at all…

I’m taking the time to thank all the drivers that get us home safely. For all the good conversations they make. I have been a difficult client to one or two drivers, as would anyone using Uber regularly as we all have bad days, and I’m sorry to those that I’ve had those experiences with, which are very few and far between. Thank you Uber, for the platform that allows safe and secure transport.

To all the drivers, thank you for all your hard work. I promise 99% of us appreciate you.

Keep it going! 🙏

I’m extremely disappointed with how Uber has been charging my card lately. I got double charged for a single trip and when the money was reversed it was smaller than the original. This is becoming a pattern, so much so that I withdraw money before ordering a car. It is an extreme inconvenience especially when the drivers themselves don’t have change and we have to make a stop somewhere to get change. Even with Uber eats the same thing happens. It’s not only the money they take that’s the problem but also the fact that each transaction is a bank charge. What a nightmare!

You cannot trust Uber anymore. The time spent waiting just to try find a ride keeps getting longer and longer and when you do find one they cancel the trip.

The drivers also complain about how Uber prices are too low… and I was paying surcharges at the time. In another ride I asked the driver to stick to the highways (because it was late at night) and he said Uber pays too little for me to take longer routes - I had to pay him cash to take the highways.

I also don’t feel safe giving the drivers poor ratings because often they’re dropping me off at my home and I don’t know if they know who rated them? If the rating comes through immediately after the ride it’s not hard to guess.

I don’t know how many times I have given Uber a chance, and they disappointed 9/10 times. I have been late so many times, consecutively, how does it take 15 minutes to get a ride and then the driver’s two minutes is 5 minutes and then on top of that, a 10 minute trip turns to 15 minutes, I am honestly done with this app, do better guys honestly. I don’t usually leave reviews for anything unless it’s good feedback but right now, I’m writing this because I’m angry and disappointed, after so many times of taking it, I can’t anymore. I’m hurt actually, I woke up early because I know the app is terrible with time in terms of finding a driver and requested 15 minutes before my actual leaving time and guess what, I was still late. Just do better!

The Uber app has been incorrectly taking money from my account. This is a problem which this company doesn’t seem to be interested in fixing, so new Users please be cautious with this app and DO NOT add your bank card as your payment method, use cash instead, I understand this might be an inconvenience to most but keeping your hard earned money safe is much better than getting small sums of it taken from your account multiple times throughout the year. I’ve had family and friends also experience this problem. Do not trust the Uber App with your banking details…they WILL deduct money from your account whenever they want and only  give back half of the money they took as a “payment correction”.

Since arriving back in SA a few weeks ago I’ve been able to use Uber and Uber Eats without hassles. However a few days ago all of a sudden only cash payments were accepted on my account due to activities on my account overstepping “terms and conditions”. Upon further enquiry I was told that there was “fraudulent activity” on my account without proof of exactly what was done wrong or without effort of further investigation. I am still unable to pay with anything except for cash and was told their decision was final.

Terrible after ride support. Something to be weary of when using Uber. Left my keys in the car they fell out my pocket when I got out. Could not get hold of the driver to speak to him personally to see if he had my keys. This happened to me last night so please be aware. 

I was out at an event & called for an Uber to pick me up (I had taken 1 earlier to get there). 

Was sent the details for a driver & I was waiting outside to be collected. He called me & said he was on the next street & if I could come there. I told him no he had to come to me. He called me back but still wouldn't come to me. I cancelled the ride. 

I requested another Uber & got a different driver. Same story but this time a guy came around the corner saying he was the driver. He was dressed too casually & I could see he was suspicious. I told him he had to bring his car out in front of the event but he wouldn't. There were other Ubers around.

This carried on for another 2 for car requests. Each time a different drivers profile came up, but yet when I called the driver the same cell number came up. 

Seems like some people have found a way to hack profiles or just register fake ones & get people to walk where they are & mug them. 

Eventually I "booked" this guy again to block him & a friend of mine called another Uber which was legitimate & we were able to leave. 

Thereafter the guy kept calling me but I ignored the call. 

Take home message:
Be aware and listen to your gut.
Never walk to where the Uber driver wants you to go.
Ask them what your name is & where you're going before giving them your info & getting in the car. 
Screen shot their profile & report them to uber for any suspicious activity. 
Check the boot incase. 

Be safe.
